data: Is the black line in the left graph consistently higher than the purple line?

The black line represents the RMSE for varying λrev while keeping λrel fixed at 0.0001. The purple line represents the RMSE for varying λrel while keeping λrev fixed at 0.005. 

In the left graph, the black line (RMSE vs λrev) is consistently higher than the purple line (RMSE vs λrel). This can be observed across all values of λrev and λrel. The black line starts at approximately 0.9468 and increases as λrev increases, while the purple line starts at approximately 0.9472 and decreases as λrel increases. Therefore, the black line is consistently higher than the purple line.
